text: 'goose': concept art, 1 designs to choose from, then up to 1 rounds of notes

concept: A LEGO model of a chunky standing goose with a curved white body, black head and neck, and an orange beak, built from stacked bricks and plates with a smooth sloped back. (changed: Made the goose stand calmly on two flat feet instead of mid-honk or flapping, since balance poses aren't buildable; Built the neck as a fixed curved stack of bricks rather than a thin free-bending shape)

score 3/10: Body is a small lumpy jumble of exposed studs and plates, not the smooth rounded goose body of the concept; Neck is far too tall and thin relative to the tiny body, ruining proportions; Beak is a plain 2x2 brick stuck on the side of the head rather than a tapered wedge/slope pointing forward
reworking the design from the critic's notes

score 3/10: Body is a lumpy cluster of exposed slopes/studs, not the smooth clean ovoid of the concept; Beak is a stubby 2x2 stud-out block instead of a tapered orange wedge; reads as a box, not a bill; No visible legs/feet — only a tiny orange tile flush with the ground instead of standing orange legs
